SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1504 North Hudson Avenue
From RM-5 to RM-5

The Property

The property is located in a Transit Served Location approximately 496.0’ to the Sedgwick CTA Brown & Purple
Lines Station entrance. The area is improved with residential uses. The property is improved with a three-story
residential building with two residential units and a two car detached garage.

The Project
1506 N HUDSON AVE LLC (the “Applicant”) proposes to rezone the property to construct a new three story

residential building (37.0’ height) with seven residential units and three surface parking spaces.

‘To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property

from a RM-S, Residential Multi-Unit District to a RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District. In addition, the Applicant is
seeking an elective Type 1 map amendment pursuant to section 17-13-0300-D to allow all relief as needed and as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Code for the attached drawings including the following relief:

1) to reduce the minimum required front setback under section 17-2-0305-B from 8.0’ to 5.0’ and reduce the rear
setback under section 17-2-0306-C from 37.08’ to 22.0° under sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-I(1);

2) to reduce the minimum required rear yard open space under section 17-2-0307 from 252 sq. ft. to 0 sq. ft. per
section 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-K;

3) to reduce the required number of off-street parking spaces under section 17-10-0207-C from seven to three for
properties located in a Transit Served Location per section 17-10-0102-B, 17-13-1101-A, 17-13-1003-EE; and

4) to reduce the bicycle parking spaces under section 17-10-0207-C from seven spaces to two spaces for properties
located in a Transit Served Location per section 17-10-0102-B(2), 17-10-0301-A, 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-
GG.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,090 square feet

Floor Area: 5,693.92 sq. ft.

Maximum FAR; 5.00

Residential Dwelling Units: 7

MLA Density: 441.43

Height: 37.0°

Bicycle Parking: an

Automobile Parking: 3+

Rear Yard Open Space: oF

Setbacks: Front (Hudson Avenue): 5.0°*
North Side: 2.0°
South Side: 3.0"
Rear (Alley): 22.0°*

A set of plans is attached.

* As indicated above, the Applicant seeks optional variations under section 17-13-0303-D.
